title: HTF Rayleigh Certificate v2
description: A replayable certificate that E0 <= interval.upper, produced by the Rayleigh-Ritz theorem. Schema v2 uses exact preconditions (exact Hermitian check, exact non-zero, NaN-closed) and a domain-separated, shape-tagged digest.

claim.description: Human-readable statement of what is certified. Must be exactly 'E0 <= {upper:.17g}  [Rayleigh-Ritz upper bound on ground-state energy]'.

assumptions.description: Machine-checked preconditions; each entry must have passed before the certificate was issued.

input_digest.description: SHA-256 hex digest of domain-separated, shape-tagged, big-endian canonical (H, psi) bytes (v2 format). Prevents input substitution and real/complex structural collisions.

interval.description: Arb/Acb interval for the Rayleigh quotient; the certified claim is E0 <= upper. All endpoints are outward-rounded binary64 via math.nextafter.

upper.description: Upper endpoint; the certified bound (outward-rounded by math.nextafter).

midpoint.description: Midpoint of [lower, upper], for display only.

radius.description: Half-width (rounding radius); 0 when backend is numpy-float.

backend.description: Arithmetic backend. 'flint-arb/prec=128' and 'flint-acb/prec=128' mean a rigorous Arb/Acb ball was computed at 128-bit precision. 'numpy-float' means no certified rounding — discovery tier only.

htf_version.description: Version of HTF that produced this certificate.

verified.description: True if verify_rayleigh_certificate() independently confirmed this certificate (strict comparison, no tolerance).
